messages:
Maya SRE: Postmortem follow-up: recurring p95 spikes for text-gen in us-west (3x in 6 days). Need owners, timelines, and an emergency SLO plan.

Dan Smith: Traces show kvcache evictions line up with spikes; big batched requests worsen tail. I'll own dashboards and alert tuning.

Rachel P: Were burning error budget fast. Suggest pausing noncritical rollouts if this continues. Can we do a short SLO override? :thinking_face:

Kyle: Short-term proposal: p95 target 200ms -> 250ms as a 24h emergency override. Add auto-rollback if extra error-budget burn >5%. Also add per-pool p95 and request-size distribution panels.

Priya Anand: I'll take kvcache retention/eviction tuning (ETA Tue EOD). @Dan Smith add panels by Mon noon? @Maya SRE draft emergency SLO note for ops.

Dan Smith: Adding panels now. Grafana query for p95 by pool: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(request_duration_seconds_bucket{job="text-gen"}[5m])) by (le, pool)) Will link when ready.

ops-bot: ticket created: RED-7812 "us-west text-gen p95 spikes - kvcache tuning + dashboard + SLO override". Canaries scheduled on next deploy.

Maya SRE: Pushed rollout policy PR with emergency override snippet and rollout gating. PR: https://git.redwood/infra/rollouts/pull/1289

Rachel P: Add an alert: p95 deviation >30ms sustained 15m -> fire with playbook pointer. We miss regressions off-hours.

Maya SRE: Added alert + runbook pointer. Severity P2, page oncall if sustained >30m.

Priya Anand: Plan recap: Priya -> kvcache tuning (Tue EOD), Dan -> dashboards/alerts (Mon noon), Maya -> SLO override PR & gating (today), Rachel -> customer comms + alert QA (Wed AM). Reconvene Wed 10am to review telemetry and decide permanent SLO change.

Dan Smith: Will post panel and alert links here once live. :thumbsup:

Maya SRE: If recurrence continues after tuning we'll consider throughput caps and per-pool quotas. Closing action-items in RED-7812. See you Wed. :calendar:
